title: Jared Verse isn't aiming to fill shoes left by Myles Garrett after trade to Browns: 'My job is to be the best me'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jared Verse isn't aiming to fill shoes left by Myles Garrett after trade to Browns: 'My job is to be the best me'
sources.description: Verse admitted he was initially upset by the move, but he appreciated how much Cleveland valued him and is motivated to hit the ground running with his new team.
